title: Checks for usages of Iterator::by_ref().peekable().peek().
summary: While it might look like this will allow peeking on the first element of an iterator without consuming it and without consuming the iterator itself, it will in practice consume the first element. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for hard to read slices of byte characters, that could be more easily expressed as a byte string.
summary: Potentially makes the string harder to read. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: It checks for str::bytes().count() and suggests replacing it with str::len().
summary: str::bytes().count() is longer and may not be as performant as using str::len(). Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for the use of .bytes().nth().
summary: .as_bytes().get() is more efficient and more readable. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.
